name: Mortis (Grave's Decay) — Basic — Destroy the Husk

system.description: You can reduce a dead body into no more than a pile of dust. Expend one Blood Trait, dripping it onto the corpse. Over the next five minutes, the corpse dissolves into a man-shaped pile of roughly 30 pounds of dust. Certain magics, including The Spirit's Touch, may allow another to determine the origin of the remaining dust, but no mortal agency can do so.
